_source: Pinellas County FY25 Adopted User Fees Schedule
_note: Fees are from FY25 Adopted schedule. Verify current rates with Pinellas County Building Services (727-464-3888) or pinellascounty.org/build/

Site Plan Review (Complex Non-Residential): $3,790.00 base + $130.00/1,000 sf above 5,000 sf
Site Plan Review (Standard Residential): $2,145.00 base + $70.00/tract or lot
Site Plan Review (Complex Residential): $3,790.00 base + $130.00/tract or lot
DRS Standard Review (base): $70.00
DRS Complex Review (base): $85.00
DRS Scope/Completeness/Zoning Verification: $15.00
Resubmittal (each after 2nd): 50% of original submittal fee
Sub-Sheet Review (minor outstanding issues): $330.00
application_fees:
Right-of-Way Permit — Commercial Driveway: $345.00
Right-of-Way Permit — Commercial Storm/Sanitary/Water Connection: $260.00 each

Subdivision Plat DRS Review: $600.00 initial; $200.00 re-submittal
Petition to Vacate — Public Right of Way or Easement: $940.00 each
Release of Property Interest: $940.00
After-the-Fact Applications: 2× normal fee

entitlements:
Standard Site Plan (No Variances / Type 1 Path B): ±2–3 months
Site Plan with Variances (requiring BCC or ZBA): ±3–6 months after DRC approval
Subdivision Plat: typically concurrent with site plan process
Land Use Change (0–5 acres): $2,050.00; 5–10 acres: $2,210.00; 10–15 acres: $2,990.00; 15+ acres: $3,140.00
perm_steps:
1. Early Assistance Development Meeting (free) or Pre-Application Meeting ($415, credited)
2. Site Plan Application + DRS Review (building, zoning, environmental, engineering)
3. DRC Meeting if required
4. Site Plan Approval / Conditions of Approval
5. Construction Drawings + Building Permit Application ($9.00/$1,000 commercial value)
6. Building Inspections + Re-inspection Fee: $75.00 if required
7. Certificate of Occupancy / Certificate of Completion
Note: Tree Permit and Sign Permit submitted concurrent with Building Permit
local_permits:
Pinellas County Building Services: 727-464-3888 | pinellascounty.org/build/
Standard Building Permit Review: ±4–8 weeks
Site Plan Review (Standard): ±4–8 weeks | Complex: ±8–12 weeks
After-Hours Inspection: $400.00
Expedited Plan Review — Commercial (0–5,000 sf): $500.00; (>5,000 sf): +50% of plan review fee
Contract Community Board of Adjustment variance advisory: $90.00/staff hour
wmd:
Southwest Florida Water Management District (SWFWMD) | 1-800-423-1476
Exemption (small sites with no wetland/water impacts, <9,000 sf impervious, <5 acres): ±2–3 months
Environmental Resource Permit (ERP) — New: ±4–6 months
ERP Minor Modification: ±3–5 months
ERP Major Modification: ±4–6 months
SWFWMD permitting can run concurrently with local/City permitting
fdep:
Florida Dept of Environmental Protection (FDEP)
Notice of Intent — General Permit for Water Main Extension: ±2 months
Notification/Application — Domestic Wastewater Collection/Transmission: ±2 months
Can run concurrently with local and SWFWMD permitting
NPDES exemption may be required for stormwater discharge
fdot:
Florida Dept of Transportation (FDOT)
Driveway Connection Permit required if project accesses a State road
Generally ±3–6 months; can run concurrent with local permitting
Contact FDOT District 7 (Tampa): 813-975-6000
staff_meetings:
Early Assistance Development Meeting (free) and/or Pre-Application Meeting ($415)
DRC (Development Review Committee) meeting if triggered by project scope
public_meetings:
Neighborhood noticing required for variance/adjustment applications ($65–$220)
BCC public hearing required for rezonings and land use amendments
Board of Adjustment variance hearing if applicable
